chapter_outcomes: R1: demonstrate understanding of explicit meaning
R2: demonstrate understanding of implicit meaning and attitude
R4: demonstrate understanding of how writers achieve effects and influence readers
Respond to comprehension questions based on a fiction text (approximately 850–950 words long from twentieth or twenty-first century)
Demonstrate understanding of figurative language, author's use of language and structure, and the effect these have
Demonstrate understanding of written texts, and of the words and phrases within them
Develop, analyse and evaluate facts, ideas and opinions
Recognise and respond to linguistic devices, figurative language and imagery

Engage with a range of genres and text types from twentieth and/or twenty-first centuries, including literature, fiction and non-fiction, blogs, essays, reviews, articles, short stories in their entirety or extracts from longer works of prose or drama
Focus on writers' use of language and style and the ways in which writers achieve effects and influence readers
Study how influence may include facts, ideas, perspectives, opinions and bias
